title: Neumorphism Style
content: Convert to neumorphic soft UI with dual shadows - light shadow on top-left (shadow-[-5px_-5px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)]) and dark shadow on bottom-right (shadow-[5px_5px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]). Use a consistent background color (bg-gray-100 or bg-slate-100) throughout. Create pressed/inset states for buttons using inset shadows. Keep colors monochromatic within the same hue family. Add generous padding and rounded corners (rounded-xl). Avoid high contrast - keep everything soft and subtle.

variants.simple: Create soft UI with inset shadows that make elements appear extruded from the background.
variants.detailed: Convert to neumorphic soft UI with dual shadows - light shadow on top-left (shadow-[-5px_-5px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)]) and dark shadow on bottom-right (shadow-[5px_5px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]). Use a consistent background color (bg-gray-100 or bg-slate-100) throughout. Create pressed/inset states for buttons using inset shadows. Keep colors monochromatic within the same hue family. Add generous padding and rounded corners (rounded-xl). Avoid high contrast - keep everything soft and subtle.
variants.advanced: Convert to neumorphic soft UI with dual shadows - light shadow on top-left (shadow-[-5px_-5px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)]) and dark shadow on bottom-right (shadow-[5px_5px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]). Use consistent background color (bg-gray-100 or bg-slate-100) throughout. Create pressed/inset states for buttons using inset shadows with smooth transitions. CRITICAL: Neumorphism has accessibility concerns - ensure minimum 3:1 contrast ratio for interactive element boundaries. Add visible focus indicators (ring-2 ring-offset-2) that stand out from soft shadows. Keep colors monochromatic within same hue family. Add generous padding (p-4 to p-6) and rounded corners (rounded-xl). Include haptic-style feedback animations for touch. Use CSS custom properties for shadow values to enable theme switching. Test with users who have low vision - consider adding subtle borders as fallback. Avoid using neumorphism for critical actions where visibility is essential.
